Any one willing to help set up CSS for the sub?
What exactly are you looking for? A banner on the top or a complete re-haul?
I'd like contributors to be able to pick their own flair.

Unfortunately I do not believe that is supported currently. As far as I know, flairs are done by mods and not the users. Though a way around it is flairs done through CSS code that is user specific. By this, I mean the sub owner or mods can have a flair appear next to a certain user, but this would mean that the user would have to ask the mods for a flair and they cannot independently add the flair themselves.

Okay, if you want to use the user-specific method, then you'd need this piece of code somewhere in the stylesheet. Usually near the end to avoid any conflicting code that might overwrite it.

[data-username~= USERNAME ]::after {

display: inline-block;
/*-----------CODE-----------*/

}

If you want to use an image flair then use:

background: url(ADDRESS);

However, if you just want to use basic text, then use:

content: " TEXT HERE ";

You can also mix it up a bit with by having text with a colored background. Remember, you'll have to do this for each user.

You might be able to find better methods if you ask around on /v/csshelp or /v/CustomizingVoat I'm sure there are more experienced tweakers who'll help you out.
